# Z-ERP by Z Systems

> Z-ERP (ZS-ERP) is a multi-branch ERP and point-of-sale (POS) system by Z Systems for Software Solutions (Port Said, Egypt). It combines cloud synchronization with an offline-capable local edition, cashier anti-theft permission controls, multi-warehouse inventory, accounting, and tax-compliant invoicing for businesses in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and the Gulf (EGP, SAR, AED, QAR, KWD, BHD, OMR).

Z Systems builds ERP, retail management, and industry platforms for high-traffic retail, wholesale, supermarkets, restaurants, fitness centers, and construction companies. Z-ERP serves retail (fashion, electronics, perfumes, optical, cosmetics), food and beverage (restaurants, cafes, bakeries, roasteries), groceries (supermarkets, minimarts, butcheries), and wholesalers (automotive parts, building materials, hardware, distribution). Key capabilities: real-time multi-branch and multi-warehouse synchronization; an offline queue that keeps issuing invoices during internet outages and syncs when the connection returns; permission controls over price changes, receipt deletions, discounts, and cash-drawer openings with a tamper-evident audit log; stock alerts, batch and serial tracking, reorder thresholds, and inter-branch transfers; tax-field invoices with QR codes, VAT calculation, and a ZATCA submission service for Saudi Arabia (verify your local authority requirements before relying on it for filings); support for barcode scanners, thermal receipt printers, electronic scales, customer displays, and cash drawers.

## Sector and solution pages

- [Supermarket POS software](https://zsystemai.com/pos-supermarket): Z-ERP point of sale for supermarkets and grocery stores, with fast barcode checkout, stock that updates with every sale, cashier anti-theft controls, and an offline-capable local edition.
- [Restaurant and café POS software](https://zsystemai.com/pos-restaurants): Z-ERP point of sale for restaurants, cafés, and bakeries, covering dine-in, takeaway, and delivery orders, tax invoices with QR codes, and a ZATCA e-invoicing submission service for Saudi Arabia.
- [Offline POS software](https://zsystemai.com/offline-pos): The Z-ERP local edition that keeps selling, invoicing, and updating stock without internet and syncs automatically when the connection returns.
- [Fashion and clothing store POS software](https://zsystemai.com/pos-fashion): Z-ERP point of sale for fashion and clothing stores, with stock organised by size and colour, barcode checkout, inter-branch transfers, cashier anti-theft controls, and an offline-capable local edition.
- [Pharmacy and cosmetics POS software](https://zsystemai.com/pos-pharmacy): Z-ERP point of sale for pharmacies and cosmetics stores, with batch tracking that helps follow expiry dates, stock alerts and reorder points, fast barcode checkout, and an offline-capable local edition.
- [Auto parts POS software](https://zsystemai.com/pos-auto-parts): Z-ERP point of sale and inventory for auto parts stores and wholesale trade, with a catalogue organised by part number and barcode, multi-warehouse stock, and tax invoices with QR codes for retail and wholesale.
- [Electronics and mobile store POS software](https://zsystemai.com/pos-electronics): Z-ERP point of sale for electronics and mobile phone stores, with serial-number tracking for every device, a sales record that helps with warranty follow-up, cashier anti-theft controls, and an offline-capable local edition.
- [Multi-branch inventory management software](https://zsystemai.com/inventory-management): Z-ERP inventory management for multiple branches and warehouses, with real-time unified balances, documented stock transfers, reorder alerts and thresholds, batch and serial tracking, and an offline local edition that syncs.
- [Saudi ZATCA e-invoicing](https://zsystemai.com/zatca-invoicing): Tax invoices with QR codes and VAT calculation for Saudi retailers, with a ZATCA e-invoicing submission service, in Saudi riyals, from the same Z-ERP POS, inventory, and accounting system.
- [Stop cashier theft and manipulation](https://zsystemai.com/pos-security): How Z-ERP protects the point of sale with per-cashier permissions over price edits, receipt deletions, discounts, and cash-drawer openings, plus a tamper-evident audit log of every exceptional action.

- [Foodics alternative for restaurants and cafés](https://zsystemai.com/alternative-foodics): Restaurant POS inside a full ERP that also runs the same owner's retail and wholesale activities in one system, with an offline local edition and a ZATCA e-invoicing submission service.
